description: Chicken pieces simmered in a rich curry sauce made with curry powder, onions and tomatoes—a Kenyan favourite with Indian influences.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken in hot oil for 6–8 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Sauté onions until golden. Add curry powder and tomatoes and cook until thick.
Return chicken, add water and salt, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve with rice.

description: Fragrant rice cooked with curry powder and onions, a simple Kenyan side with a warm spice aroma.

steps.instruction: Rinse rice. Heat oil and sauté onion until soft.
Stir in curry powder and rice. Add water and salt.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until tender. Fluff and serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve with beef stew or grilled chicken.

description: Yellow lentils simmered with curry powder, onions and tomatoes, a comforting Kenyan vegetarian stew.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until soft. Add curry powder and tomatoes, cook until saucy.
Add lentils and water. Bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20–25 minutes until lentils are soft. Season and serve with rice.

description: Chicken pieces cooked with plenty of fresh ginger, garlic and onions—a warming Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Grate or crush ginger. Brown chicken in oil for 6–8 minutes.
Add onion and ginger, cook until soft. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add salt and water, simmer for 20 minutes. Serve with rice.

description: A warming Kenyan tea brewed with fresh ginger, milk and sugar—served daily in homes and cafes.

steps.instruction: Peel and grate ginger. Bring water to a boil and add ginger.
Boil for 2 minutes, then add tea leaves, milk and sugar.
Simmer for 5 minutes, strain and serve hot.

description: Tilapia simmered with fresh ginger, tomatoes and onions—a fragrant coastal Kenyan fish dish.

steps.instruction: Clean and score tilapia. Fry in oil for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove.
Sauté onion and grated ginger until soft. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add water, return fish and simmer for 8–10 minutes. Serve with ugali.

description: A garlic-forward Kenyan chicken stew where plenty of crushed garlic is cooked with chicken pieces, onions and tomatoes.

steps.instruction: Crush garlic cloves. Heat oil and brown chicken for 6–8 minutes.
Add chopped onions and cook until soft. Stir in crushed garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and salt, cook until saucy. Add water and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve with ugali and sukuma wiki.

description: Fragrant rice cooked with sautéed garlic and onions, a simple Kenyan side with a bold aroma.

steps.instruction: Rinse rice. Heat oil and sauté minced garlic and onion until golden.
Add rice and stir to coat. Pour in water and salt.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until tender. Fluff and serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve with grilled fish or chicken.

description: Spinach sautéed with plenty of garlic and onions, a quick and healthy Kenyan side dish.

steps.instruction: Heat oil and sauté minced garlic and onion until fragrant.
Add spinach and salt, stir-fry for 5–7 minutes until wilted.
Serve hot with ugali or rice.

serving_suggestion: Serve with ugali or as a side.

description: Chicken pieces cooked in a vibrant tomato sauce with onions and garlic—a simple, comforting Kenyan dish.

steps.instruction: Boil chicken with salt and water until tender, about 25 minutes. Reserve broth.
Heat oil and sauté onions until golden. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until thick sauce.
Add chicken and a little broth, simmer for 10–15 minutes. Serve with rice.

description: Rice cooked with a rich tomato and onion base, giving a colourful and flavourful Kenyan side.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion in oil until soft. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add rice and stir to coat. Pour in water and salt.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until rice is tender. Fluff and serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve with grilled chicken or fish.

description: A fresh, zesty salad of tomatoes, onions, and coriander—the classic Kenyan condiment.

steps.instruction: Chop tomatoes, red onion and coriander.
Combine in a bowl, squeeze lemon juice over and add salt.
Toss gently and serve fresh.

serving_suggestion: Serve with nyama choma or pilau.

description: A deeply savoury Kenyan stew where onions are cooked down until sweet and golden, forming the backbone of a rich gravy.

steps.instruction: Brown beef in oil and set aside.
In the same pot, cook sliced onions on medium-low for 12 minutes until golden and sweet.
Add tomatoes if using and cook until saucy. Return beef, add salt and water, simmer for 20 minutes.

description: Rice cooked with caramelised onions, a simple Kenyan side with a sweet, rich flavour.

steps.instruction: Slice onions and fry in oil until deep golden, about 10 minutes.
Add rice and stir to coat. Pour in water and salt.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Fluff and serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve with grilled meat or fish.

description: A rich, comforting Kenyan onion soup made with caramelised onions and a touch of milk.

steps.instruction: Slice onions and cook in oil on low heat for 20 minutes until caramelised.
Add water and salt, simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in milk, heat through and serve with bread.

description: Beef cubes simmered in a spiced curry sauce with onions and tomatoes—a hearty Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Boil beef until tender, about 30 minutes. Reserve broth.
Sauté onions until golden. Add curry powder and tomatoes, cook until saucy.
Add beef and broth, simmer for 15 minutes. Serve with ugali or rice.

description: Beef strips stir-fried with fresh ginger, garlic and onions, a fragrant Kenyan dish.

steps.instruction: Slice beef thinly. Heat oil and stir-fry beef for 3–4 minutes.
Add grated ginger and onion, cook until soft.
Season with salt, cook for 5 minutes and serve with rice.

name_sw: Nyama ya Ng'ombe ya Kitunguu Saumu
description: Beef pieces cooked with plenty of garlic, onions and tomatoes—a bold Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Brown beef in oil. Remove.
Sauté onion and crushed garlic until fragrant. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Return beef, add water and salt, simmer for 30 minutes. Serve.

description: Beef simmered in a rich tomato sauce with onions and garlic—a Kenyan weeknight favourite.

steps.instruction: Boil beef until tender, about 30 minutes. Reserve broth.
Sauté onions until golden. Add tomatoes and cook until thick.
Add beef and broth, simmer for 10 minutes. Serve with rice.

description: A deeply savoury Kenyan beef stew where onions are cooked down until sweet and golden.

steps.instruction: Brown beef in oil. Remove.
Cook sliced onions on medium-low for 10–12 minutes until golden.
Add tomatoes if using, then return beef, add salt and water, simmer for 30 minutes.

description: Tilapia simmered in a spiced curry sauce with tomatoes and onions.

steps.instruction: Clean and score tilapia. Fry in oil for 3 minutes per side. Remove.
Sauté onion until soft. Add curry powder and tomatoes, cook until saucy.
Add water, return fish and simmer for 8 minutes. Serve.

description: A soothing Kenyan chicken soup infused with fresh ginger and garlic.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion, garlic and grated ginger in oil until fragrant.
Add chicken and brown for 5 minutes. Add water and salt.
Simmer for 30 minutes, strain and serve hot.

serving_suggestion: Serve as a starter or light meal.

description: Fragrant pilau rice cooked with plenty of garlic, pilau masala and onions.

steps.instruction: Fry onions until golden. Add crushed garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add pilau masala and rice, stir to coat. Add water and salt.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Fluff and serve.

description: Tilapia simmered in a tangy tomato and onion sauce—a favourite way to enjoy fresh fish.

steps.instruction: Fry tilapia in oil for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove.
Sauté onion until soft. Add tomatoes and cook until thick sauce.
Add water, return fish and simmer for 8 minutes. Serve.

description: A rustic Kenyan chicken stew built on a generous base of slow-cooked onions and garlic.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken in oil. Remove.
Cook sliced onions on medium-low for 10 minutes until golden.
Add tomatoes if using, return chicken, add salt and water, simmer for 25 minutes.

description: Mixed vegetables simmered in a spiced curry sauce with onions and tomatoes—a healthy Kenyan side.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until golden. Add curry powder and tomatoes, cook until saucy.
Add carrots, potatoes and water, simmer for 10 minutes.
Add green beans and salt, cook for 10 minutes until tender. Serve.

description: Fragrant rice cooked with fresh ginger and onions, a warming Kenyan side dish.

steps.instruction: Grate ginger. Heat oil and sauté ginger and onion until fragrant.
Add rice and stir. Pour in water and salt.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Fluff and serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve with grilled meat or fish.

name_sw: Pasta ya Kitunguu Saumu na Nyanya
description: A simple Kenyan pasta dish tossed in a garlicky tomato sauce, a popular home meal.

steps.instruction: Cook pasta in salted water until al dente. Drain.
Sauté garlic and onion in oil until fragrant. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Toss pasta in the sauce, season with salt and serve.
